# A workspace's nested neo.mjs install runs the maintainer prepare step

## Context

In the cloud cold walk for neomjs/neo#20114 (2026-10-26, `npx neo-app@13.3.2`), the install log shows:

```
> myapp@0.1.0 postinstall
> cd node_modules/neo.mjs && npm i && npm run bundle-parse5 && npm run bundle-marked
> neo.mjs@13.3.1 prepare
> node ./buildScripts/util/prepare.mjs

.git can't be foundneo-agent-skills: materialized 39 link(s) into .claude/skills → node_modules
neo-agent-skills: .claude/skills/ must be git-ignored — these are projection artifacts, never committed bytes.

added 543 packages, and audited 544 packages in 19s
```

## The Problem

Every scaffolded workspace runs the engine's **maintainer** `prepare` inside its dependency:
- husky prints `.git can't be found` with no trailing newline, so the next line runs into it;
- the skills materializer links 39 maintainer skills into `node_modules/neo.mjs/.claude/skills`, from the engine's own `neo-agent-skills` devDependency rather than the workspace's app audience.

That means confusing install output, maintainer artifacts in a consumer's `node_modules`, and work no consumer needs.

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/util/prepare.mjs` guards both stages with `isDependencyBuild({env, root})`, which returns true only when `INIT_CWD` differs from the package root. That catches a git-dependency install.
- The workspace's `postinstall` (written by neomjs/create-app `tasks/createPackageJson.mjs`) runs `npm i` with its cwd *inside* `node_modules/neo.mjs`, so `INIT_CWD` equals `root` and the guard reads "not a dependency".

## The Fix

Extend `isDependencyBuild` so a package root that sits inside a `node_modules` directory also counts as a dependency build. That keeps the two stages scoped to a real checkout, without depending on how the consumer invokes npm. A maintainer clone is unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `isDependencyBuild` returns true for a root inside `node_modules` even when `INIT_CWD` equals that root, and stays false for a top-level clone (unit arms, red-first on `dev`).
- [ ] AC-2: under that condition `prepare.mjs` runs neither husky nor the materializer, and prints nothing.
- [ ] AC-3 (post-release): a fresh `npx neo-app` install log no longer shows `.git can't be found` or a skills materialization inside `node_modules/neo.mjs`.

## Out of Scope

- Whether the workspace's nested `npm i` in `node_modules/neo.mjs` is needed at all (543 packages, 19 s of the 58 s install). That is the scaffold's `postinstall` design, a separate question for neomjs/create-app.
